YOUR DATA, YOUR WORKSPACE

Bring your spend together.

Combine spend from up to three Singapore LBUs in one CSV. Add an LBU column to identify which unit owns each row. Files are processed in this browser and stay in memory until you refresh.

CSV columns

month,lbu,vendor,category,amount_sgd

Use YYYY-MM dates and numbers such as 12500.50. Negative credits are supported. All LBUs belong to Singapore. Optional country and currency columns must be Singapore and SGD. Identical month / LBU / supplier / category rows are combined. Supplier names match after trimming and lowercasing.
